name: annzar-voice-shop-mcp
description: MCP server for voice-controlled shop management (Amazon Developer Hackathon, Alexa+ track)

scripts.inspect:
node -e "console.log('
  Start the server first:
    npm run dev

  Then open the MCP Inspector:
    npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector http://localhost:3000/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $MCP_API_KEY"

  Or with curl:
    curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/mcp -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCP_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/list","id":1}' | jq .
')"
